Name: Data Quality and Reference Data Policy
Description: Rules ensuring master data is complete, valid, consistent and identified once: data quality, reference data, identity and matching.
Purpose: Make golden data fit for operations, reporting and AI by validating it against standards (ISO 8000, ISO 3166, ISO 4217, GS1) at the point of entry.

Name: Personal Data Protection Policy
Description: Rules for collecting, classifying, exposing and retaining personal data in master data products.
Purpose: Implement data protection by design and by default (GDPR Art. 25) and the consumer rights of CCPA/CPRA in every data product.

Name: Data Security and Records Retention Policy
Description: Rules for roles, privileges, segregation of duties, masking, historization and retention of master data.
Purpose: Apply ISO/IEC 27001 controls (access control, data masking, information deletion, protection of records) to data products.

Name: Metadata, Modeling and Stewardship Policy
Description: Rules for naming, documenting and stewarding data products so that people and AI agents understand and trust them.
Purpose: Make every data product self-describing (ISO/IEC 11179) with named owners and stewardship processes.

Name: Responsible AI Data Usage Policy
Description: Rules for how AI agents and AI systems access, use and change master data and governance content.
Purpose: Keep AI agents on governed, approved and minimised data, with human oversight of changes (EU AI Act, GDPR).

Name: GxP and Health Data Extension Policy
Description: Pharma extension: rules for medicinal product, healthcare professional and clinical site master data.
Purpose: Meet 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, IDMP, HIPAA and Sunshine Act obligations. Scoped only to pharma domains and attribute types.
